question: Active HRSA Section 330 grant (H80 award)
help_text: Without active 330 grant, FQHC designation is lost; no access to any FQHC capital programs. Notice of Award (NOA) must be current.
lead_time: Already in hand (12-18 mo if new)

question: HRSA scope of project (approved service sites & services)
help_text: Capital project must be within approved scope; unapproved scope = Change in Scope (CIS) required before closing.

question: BPHC Operational Site Visit (OSV) results — most recent
help_text: Outstanding conditions = deal risk. Progressive Action (PA) or Immediate Action (IA) findings must be disclosed.

question: UDS (Uniform Data System) reports — 3 most recent years
help_text: Includes patient demographics, clinical quality measures, financial data, staffing. UDS data quality issues raise management capacity questions.

question: Section 330 compliance checklist — 19 program requirements
help_text: Includes: governance (51% patient board), sliding fee, QI/QA program, after-hours coverage, etc. Non-compliance can lead to grant conditions or termination.

question: FTCA (Federal Tort Claims Act) deeming letter — current
help_text: FTCA deeming = free malpractice coverage; loss of deeming = must purchase insurance = major cost increase. Renewed annually.

question: 340B Drug Pricing Program enrollment and compliance
help_text: 340B savings are material revenue; loss of eligibility is a disclosed risk factor. HRSA 340B audits have increased.
lead_time: Already in hand; audit results 1-2 weeks

question: Health Center Program Compliance Manual attestation
help_text: Annual attestation required by HRSA; false attestation risk.

question: IRS 501(c)(3) determination letter
help_text: Tax-exempt status foundational for all FQHC financing channels.

question: Board composition documentation — 51%+ patient majority
help_text: Section 330 requires majority patient-governed board; non-compliance = grant risk.

question: Board member conflict of interest disclosures
help_text: HRSA requires annual COI disclosures; more stringent than typical nonprofit.

question: Articles of Incorporation & Bylaws
help_text: Must reflect FQHC governance requirements (patient board majority, sliding fee commitment).

question: Board authorization resolution for financing
help_text: Specific to the financing transaction.

question: Certificate of Good Standing (state)
help_text: Current within 60-90 days.

question: Collaborative/contractual agreements for required services
help_text: Section 330 requires all primary care services be available; some via contracts.

question: Existing debt schedule & loan documents
help_text: Prior HRSA facility grants may have reverter clauses; existing CDFI loans have covenants.

question: HRSA property records & federal interest inventory
help_text: Assets built/renovated with federal funds have federal interest; encumbrance complicates financing. Must be calculated and disclosed.

question: List of pending litigation
help_text: FTCA-covered claims handled by HHS, but non-FTCA claims must be disclosed.

question: Insurance certificates
help_text: If FTCA-deemed: professional liability covered by federal government; still need property, D&O, general liability.

question: State FQHC/clinic license (varies by state)
help_text: Not all states require separate FQHC license; verify state-specific requirements.

question: Medicare enrollment (CMS-855A/B)
help_text: FQHC-specific Medicare PPS rate is typically higher than fee-for-service; loss = major revenue hit.

question: Medicaid enrollment & managed care contracts
help_text: Medicaid is ~45% of FQHC revenue; managed care wrap-around PPS payments are complex.

question: CLIA certificate(s) for all lab sites
help_text: FQHCs typically have waived CLIA certificates at multiple sites.

question: DEA registration(s) — all applicable sites
help_text: Required if controlled substances dispensed or administered.

question: State pharmacy license (if on-site pharmacy/340B)
help_text: Required for FQHCs with in-house pharmacies or 340B contract pharmacy arrangements.

question: Behavioral health licensure (if integrated BH services)
help_text: Many FQHCs provide integrated behavioral health; state licensure requirements vary.

question: Dental program licensure/permits
help_text: ~70% of FQHCs provide dental services; facility requirements vary by state.

question: Joint Commission / AAAHC accreditation
help_text: Unlike hospitals, FQHC accreditation is not required for reimbursement. Some FQHCs pursue AAAHC voluntarily.

question: State Health Department inspection reports
help_text: Site-specific inspection results for all locations.

question: Audited financial statements (3 most recent FYs)
help_text: FQHCs with >$750K in federal expenditures require Single Audit (2 CFR 200).

question: Single Audit findings & corrective action plans
help_text: Material weakness or significant deficiency on H80 grant program = deal risk.

question: Interim financial statements (YTD)
help_text: Must be within 60-90 days of application/closing.

question: UDS financial tables — revenue by source
help_text: Granular view: grants, Medicaid, Medicare, commercial, self-pay, 340B revenue.

question: HRSA grant budget vs. actuals (most recent budget period)
help_text: Available from HRSA Electronic Handbooks (EHB); demonstrates fiscal management.

question: 5-year financial projections
help_text: Must account for: federal grant volatility, Medicaid policy risk, PPS rate changes.

question: Payor mix with FQHC-specific detail
help_text: Must separate: Medicaid FFS, Medicaid managed care (wrap), Medicare, commercial, sliding fee, uninsured, grant-supported.

question: Sliding Fee Discount Program (SFDP) schedule & utilization
help_text: Required by Section 330; sliding fee patients are a cost center offset by grants. Schedule A-D; % of patients at each discount tier.

question: Days cash on hand (DCOH)
help_text: FQHC median DCOH is ~60-90 days (lower than hospitals); <45 days is concerning.

question: Operating margin (with and without grant revenue)
help_text: Many FQHCs are operationally unprofitable without federal grants; must show both.

question: Cost per patient/visit trends
help_text: UDS provides visit counts; key efficiency metric for CDFI/NMTC applications.

question: Debt service coverage ratio (DSCR) — historical
help_text: FQHC DSCR thresholds may be lower than hospital (1.10-1.20x acceptable for CDFI); 1.25x+ for bonds.

question: Capital expenditure history and plan
help_text: Must align with approved scope of project.

question: HRSA Change in Scope (CIS) approval — if adding new site
help_text: Cannot open new site without HRSA CIS approval; financing may close before CIS is granted [risk].

question: HRSA prior approval for capital expenditure >$250K (if grant-funded)
help_text: Required when using grant funds for capital; threshold is $250K for equipment, any amount for construction.

question: Architectural/engineering plans
help_text: Must comply with ADA, state building codes, and HRSA facility standards.

question: Community needs assessment (CNA) — current
help_text: Required by Section 330; demonstrates need for expanded capacity. HRSA requires CNA every 3 years.

question: Environmental review (Phase I ESA)
help_text: Contamination = deal delay + cost increase.

question: NEPA environmental review (if federal funds involved)
help_text: HRSA requires NEPA compliance for federally-funded construction; often overlooked. Even partial federal funding triggers NEPA.

question: Title report / title insurance commitment
help_text: Standard for bond-financed real estate.

question: Site control documentation (lease, deed, option)
help_text: Many FQHCs lease space; lease terms must support financing timeline. Landlord estoppel may be required.

question: Construction budget and timeline
help_text: Must align with HRSA budget if grant-funded.

question: NMTC allocation letter (if NMTC financing)
help_text: NMTC allocations are highly competitive; allocation is the gate.

question: CDFI loan application package
help_text: Varies by CDFI; CHC Capital Fund, Capital Link, IFF, LISC are common FQHC CDFIs.

question: HRSA Electronic Handbooks (EHB) access & current submissions
help_text: EHB is HRSA's portal for all grant management; delinquent submissions = grant risk.

question: Quality Improvement/Quality Assurance (QI/QA) plan — current
help_text: Required by Section 330; absence signals management weakness.

question: Health center governing board meeting minutes (12 months)
help_text: Demonstrates active governance; HRSA reviews during OSV.

question: Credentialing and privileging records for all providers
help_text: Required by Section 330; gaps are common OSV findings.

question: HIPAA compliance documentation
help_text: Risk analysis, policies, breach history.

question: Patient-Centered Medical Home (PCMH) recognition
help_text: Not required but increasingly valued by funders. NCQA PCMH recognition is common among FQHCs.

question: Value-based payment readiness assessment
help_text: Relevant for demonstrating financial sustainability beyond fee-for-service.

question: Continuing disclosure compliance history
help_text: Only applicable if FQHC has prior bond issuance. Check EMMA filings.

question: Feasibility study (or financial advisory report)
help_text: Typically $40K-$100K; required for unrated or lower-rated deals.

question: Rating agency presentation (if seeking rating)
help_text: Rated FQHC deal is extremely rare; most proceed unrated.

question: HRSA approval for use of federally-funded property as collateral
help_text: Federal interest in property may prevent pledging as bond security. HRSA must approve.

question: Bond counsel engagement
help_text: Orrick has FQHC experience (On Lok deals).

question: Underwriter selection or bank selection (private placement)
help_text: Limited FQHC deal experience in market.

question: Conduit issuer application (state HFA)
help_text: CHFFA, MassDevelopment, NJHCFFA all have FQHC programs; application requirements vary.

question: Preliminary Official Statement drafting
help_text: FQHC-specific disclosures: HRSA grant status, 330 compliance, FTCA deeming, 340B, patient governance.
